title: Account menu
responsibility: Shows the signed-in person and links for leaving the workspace, managing project members and signing out.

inputs.name: AccountMenu.projectId
inputs.description: An optional project UUID used as the Members route parameter; it defaults to undefined when omitted. When a session actor exists and the value is truthy, the component renders a Members link for that project; otherwise it omits that link.

outputs.name: AccountMenu
outputs.description: When a session actor exists, renders the actor name with email tooltip, a Projects link, a Members link only for a truthy projectId, and a Sign out button; otherwise it renders nothing. Projects and Members trigger document navigation, and Sign out calls session.signOut() and is disabled while the session is busy.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown during component initialization when browserContext() has no provided context, because the implementation destructures session from its return value.
